goal: Avoid full right-table materialization when an indexed left-driven JOIN probe can satisfy the join.
scope: Preserve hash join and nested-loop fallback behavior
implementation: Load the right table schema before probing, without scanning right table rows.
Prefix the schema for join-key extraction and result schema construction on the probe path.
Attempt indexed probe using the existing primary-key/BTree fetch path.
Defer right table scan until after the probe path is known to be unavailable.
